issue.title: Add the -I 'ignore only warnings' command line option

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
zap-baseline.py contains a command line option "-I 'ignore only warnings'" that is missing from the zap-full-scan.py and zap-api-scan.py scripts.  This modifies both scripts to include the option.

Fixes zaproxy/zaproxy#5928.

issue.title: zap-api-scan.py is missing the  -I option

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
zap-api-scan.py is missing the  -I option

**To Reproduce**
I'm using GitLab CI and owasp/zap2docker-stable as the base image
Here's my gitlab-ci.yml:
```
script: 
   zap-api-scan.py
      -t ABC/swagger/swagger.json
      -f openapi
      -r ${FILENAME_ZAP_REPORT}.html
      -I
```

**Expected behavior**
It shouldn't return error code 2 even if there are warnings.

**Software versions**
- Gitlab CI
- owasp/zap2docker-stable as the base image

**Errors from the zap.log file**
Error Message from GitLab:
`2020-06-24 15:48:21,095 Invalid option I : option -I not recognized`

**Would you like to help fix this issue?**
According to the [source code ](https://github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy/blob/develop/docker/zap-api-scan.py)of the Python script the -I option is included. Why is it not recognized anymore?

issue.title: Documentation error: -I flag is not supported with zap-full-scan.py

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**

The documentation at https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/docker/full-scan/ says that `-I` is a supported flag ('do not return failure on warning')

But the script throws an error `Invalid option I : option -I not recognized`

**Expected behavior**

Either `-I` should be supported in full-scan mode, or the documentation should not say that it is supported.

**Screenshots**

```
Command output: 2020-11-05 03:08:18,978 Invalid option I : option -I not recognized
Usage: zap-full-scan.py -t <target> [options]
    -t target         target URL including the protocol, e.g. https://www.example.com

    -m mins           the number of minutes to spider for (defaults to no limit)

    -w report_md      file to write the full ZAP Wiki(Markdown) report
```
